name: CI/CD

on:
  pull_request: {}
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'

jobs:
  lint:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          components: rustfmt, clippy
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          key: lint
      - name: Check formatting
        run: cargo fmt -- --check
      - name: Run clippy
        run: cargo clippy -- -D warnings

  test:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          key: test
      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test --workspace --all-features

  security:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          key: security
      - name: Install cargo-audit
        run: cargo install cargo-audit
      - name: Run cargo audit
        run: cargo audit

  create_release:
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install git-cliff
        run: cargo install git-cliff
      - name: Generate changelog
        run: git-cliff --output CHANGELOG.md
      - name: Create GitHub release
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          release_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          body_path: CHANGELOG.md
          draft: false
          prerelease: false

  build_and_upload:
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
    needs: create_release
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            format: tar.gz
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            format: tar.gz
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            format: tar.gz
          - os: macos-latest
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            format: tar.gz
          - os: macos-latest
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            format: tar.gz
          - os: windows-latest
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            format: zip
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          target: ${{ matrix.target }}
          components: rustfmt, clippy
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          key: build-${{ matrix.target }}
      - name: Build
        run: cargo build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }}
      - name: Package tar.gz
        if: matrix.format == 'tar.gz'
        run: |
          cd target/${{ matrix.target }}/release
          tar -czf ../../keifu-${{ matrix.target }}.tar.gz *
        shell: bash
      - name: Package zip
        if: matrix.format == 'zip'
        run: |
          cd target/${{ matrix.target }}/release
          Compress-Archive -Path * -DestinationPath ../../keifu-${{ matrix.target }}.zip
        shell: pwsh
      - name: Upload asset
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ needs.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ${{ github.workspace }}/keifu-${{ matrix.target }}.${{ matrix.format }}
          asset_name: keifu-${{ matrix.target }}.${{ matrix.format }}
          asset_content_type: application/octet-stream

  publish:
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
    needs: build_and_upload
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: crates.io
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
      - name: Publish to crates.io
        run: cargo publish --token ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
